What Dad whispered, every night. 🌙 The same words, night after night… words Daniel never heard. Or so Dad thought.

At five, under a dinosaur night-light, Dad tucked him in and whispered them. 🦕 At nine, he knelt by the bed and whispered them again. Daniel didn't move.

At thirteen, headphones on: "You never even…" Dad whispered them anyway. 🎧 Times he said them in daylight? Zero.

At seventeen, the night before he left home, Dad whispered them one last time. Daniel's eyes were still closed. 🥹

The next morning, by the car, Daniel pulled his dad into a hug… and said every word back, out loud. 🚗❤️ He'd heard them all along.

"I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you." Jeremiah 31:3 (ESV) 🙏 God said it, and then Jesus rose to prove it.

Dads, keep whispering. Even when you think they're not listening, they are. ❤️ And if your child lies awake at night with worries, your words can be the last ones they hear.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
